# Global Equity Valuations Deep Dive Analysis

Report 123 | Published 2023-11-12 | Evaluated 2026-11-07

[Original member article](https://www.lynalden.com/premium-2023-11-12/) | [Article index](README.md) | [Structured review](../data/reviews/123.json)

Global valuations meet fiscal and liquidity constraints.

The two-year Bitcoin forecast and ETF sequencing worked. The real-equity recovery delay faces strong contrary evidence, while the broad Wilshire comparison requires index-specific verification. International holdings appreciated but lagged the US in the evaluator window, and Itau has not completed its five-year horizon. The framework is strongest when separating liquidity components and valuation composition; it is less decisive when fiscal dominance or capital-flow narratives become broad timing explanations.

**Coverage:** All blocks 0-127 and 22 image labels read. Coverage includes Treasury issuance, credit-cycle interpretation, real equity horizon, crypto access and supply, international valuation caveats, capital-flow catalysts, Brazil and defensive allocations. Charts were not visually inspected; no portfolio performance is inferred.

The official release confirms slower increases in long-tenor auctions relative to shorter coupons, but bills were scheduled for modest December reductions. Relative issuance composition must be distinguished from an absolute increase or inability to sell duration.

**Direction:** Separable components differ.

**Timing:** No fixed deadline stated.

**Mechanism:** Evaluate the explanation separately from subsequent price direction.

**Reviewer confidence:** medium

**Outcome evidence:**

- [November 2023 refunding](https://home.treasury.gov/news/press-releases/jy1864) | U.S. Treasury | 2023-11-01 | Verified in the audit

Treasury increased coupon auctions, with a more moderate increase in longer tenors. Bills would remain at current auction sizes until late November, then decline modestly. This confirms a relative maturity adjustment, not abandonment of long-bond issuance.

At a uniform 5% effective rate, $34 tn times 0.05 equals $1.7 tn. This is a conditional gross-interest calculation, not a dated net-budget-interest forecast; debt composition, intragovernmental holdings and refinancing speed matter.

**Timing:** No fixed deadline stated.

**Mechanism:** Evaluate the explanation separately from subsequent price direction.

**Reviewer confidence:** high

**Deductive assessment:**

- Fixed gross debt of $34tn
- Uniform effective rate of 5% after full refinancing

Annual gross interest = debt times rate = $34 tn * 0.05 = $1.7 tn.

### 123-C16

**Real recovery delayed**

| Field | Assessment |
| --- | --- |
| Verdict | Wrong |
| Type | forecast |
| Horizon | At least 5-10 years |
| Conditions | Not specified |
| Author modality | guess |
| Asset or variable | us-equities-real-peak |
| Source blocks | 37 |
| Thesis family | us-equities-real-peak |

The S&P 500 regained its late-2021 CPI-adjusted peak by June 2024. Broad-market VTI also exceeded its 2021 real closing-price high on July 10, 2024, under three years after the original high. These contradict the general 5-10 year minimum delay. VTI is a proxy, not the exact Wilshire series in the chart; index-specific rebasing and constituent differences remain.

**Direction:** Contradicted by both large-cap and broad-market real-price proxies.

**Timing:** At least 5-10 years

**Mechanism:** Outcome evidence does not independently identify the proposed causal mechanism.

**Reviewer confidence:** medium

**Outcome evidence:**

- [Real S&P peak comparison](https://fred.stlouisfed.org/series/SP500) | S&P Dow Jones / FRED | 2026-11-07 | Verified in the audit

Latest-vintage daily SP 500 divided by same-month CPIAUCSL: late 2021 maximum at December 29, 4793.06/CPI 280.845. First post-October 29 2023 exceedance June 5 2024, 5354.03/CPI 313.044. Price index excludes dividends; monthly deflator is ex-post, not a tradable signal. CPI source https://fred.stlouisfed.org/series/CPIAUCSL .

- [Broad-market VTI real-price comparison](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/VTI/history/) | Yahoo Finance and BLS via FRED | 2026-11-07 | Verified in the audit

Unadjusted daily VTI close divided by latest-vintage same-month CPIAUCSL: 2021 maximum November 16, $242.789993 / CPI 278.919 = 0.870467746. First postpublication exceedance July 10, 2024, $275.059998 / CPI 313.569 = 0.877191296. Dividend exclusion and ex-post monthly deflator match price-level analysis, not an executable strategy. VTI is a broad-market proxy rather than Wilshire.

### 123-C17

**Unemployment rule**

| Field | Assessment |
| --- | --- |
| Verdict | Mixed |
| Type | explanation |
| Horizon | Not specified |
| Conditions | Not specified |
| Author modality | asserted |
| Asset or variable | recession-unemployment-rule |
| Source blocks | 40, 42 |
| Thesis family | recession-unemployment-rule |

The caveat about unusual cycles is appropriate. A raw 0.5-point rise is not the Sahm rule, and subsequent Fed research documents false positives, including 2003; the universal historical formulation is overstrong.

**Direction:** Separable components differ.

**Timing:** No fixed deadline stated.

**Mechanism:** Evaluate the explanation separately from subsequent price direction.

**Reviewer confidence:** medium

**Outcome evidence:**

- [SOS recession indicator research](https://www.richmondfed.org/publications/research/economic_brief/2025/eb_25-07) | Richmond Fed | Verified in the audit

February 2025 study reports Sahm false positives in 2003 and 2024 in its 1971-2024 sample. Sahm uses a three-month unemployment average relative to a trailing twelve-month low, not a raw monthly rise from a cycle low.

## Analytical tools and charts

- **Liquidity:** Funding and currency. Visual inspection: not performed.
- **Credit:** Cycle and real prices. Visual inspection: not performed.
- **Global valuations:** Composition and valuation. Visual inspection: not performed.

## Framework lessons

- Separate credit momentum from the level of restriction.
- Country valuations require sector and currency context.

## Verification limitations

- Current snapshot is not an authenticated publication-date vintage.
- Image labels were inventoried; chart images were not inspected.
- No portfolio or equity total returns are inferred from business results.
